mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, wallet_id, payment_key, order_id, amount, status, requested_at, approved_at FROM deposit_histories WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deposit_histories ( member_id, wallet_id, order_id, amount, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{walletId}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, #{status} )
